_what: The studio's libraries. Each is copied into every new game at creation, and into an older game that asks for it, under studio/, and the version that game got is recorded in its studio/studio.json. Bump `version` when the files change and every game holding an older one offers to update. `files` are the library's own, read-only to helpers; `seeds` are the game's own companion files, written once and never replaced.

input.title: Controls
input.what: One way in for the keyboard, a game controller and a touchscreen, for one player or two.

sound.title: Sounds
sound.what: Plays the sounds in assets/sounds/ with one call — overlapping shots, loops, mute — and never breaks the game over a missing file.

sprites.title: Sprites
sprites.what: Draws the pictures in assets/sprites/ by name, animated when the picture is a film strip of square frames, and never breaks the game over a missing one.

screens.title: Screens
screens.what: A phone-fit title and game-over screen, and a one-line how-to-play hint worked out from config/controls.js and the device — keys on a keyboard, the touch scheme's own shape on a phone, controller buttons when one is plugged in.
